name: Sentura Approval
description: Context-aware HITL approval — evaluates policy rules to auto-approve, auto-deny, or route requests through configurable escalation chains with timeouts. Wraps OpenClaw's binary exec.approval / plugin.approval primitives with enterprise context (refund amounts, risk tiers, department ownership).

dataDir.description: Directory for approval log + policy store. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/sentura-approval/

defaultTimeoutMs.description: Fallback timeout (ms) for approvals that don't specify one. Default 30 minutes.

defaultOnTimeout.description: Decision applied when an approval expires without a human response.
